name: Hers Anyways -Mireille Story-
source:
It's not always easy to live in the city when you are a shy mermaid in need of special care at times. Fortunately, Mireille can count on her best friend, Hal, whenever she need a little help ~ 

[From [url=https://luviesoft.itch.io/mireille-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你是一条有时需要特别照顾的害羞美人鱼时，在城市生活并不总是那么容易。幸运的是，当米雷耶需要一点帮助时，她可以依靠她最好的朋友哈尔~ 

[来自[url=https://luviesoft.itch.io/mireille-demo]itch.io[/url]]
